help_guide_intro_body: ATAA supports beneficiaries through medical, education, and orphan sponsorship programs. Follow the steps below and submit clear documents to improve approval chances.
help_guide_step1_body: Sign up with phone or email and complete your profile accurately.
help_guide_step2_body: From Home, pick a medical, education, or orphan sponsorship request based on your need.
help_guide_step3_title: Fill the form and upload documents
help_guide_step3_body: Enter the required data and upload clear ID and supporting reports or family records.
help_guide_step4_body: On Home you can follow your published case with a progress bar. When the amount is complete you will get a notification to credit your wallet or collect from the association center.
help_guide_step5_title: Wait for the association to contact you
help_guide_step5_body: If approved, ATAA will contact you to continue. You can also reach us from Contact Us.
help_guide_benefits_desc: Each program covers a different need. Choose what fits your situation:
help_guide_medical_body: Support for treatment, tests, or related medical costs after reviewing reports and documents.
help_guide_education_body: Help for school and university students such as tuition or device support based on the request type.
help_guide_orphan_body: Support for orphans through a sponsorship request with family booklet and father’s death certificate when required.
help_guide_tip1: Make sure the national ID and name match official documents.
help_guide_tip2: Upload clear, uncropped photos of IDs and reports.
help_guide_tip3: Describe your need briefly and clearly without missing details.
help_guide_tip4: Do not submit multiple requests for the same need at once; track the current one first.

about_tagline: We deliver giving to those who need it with transparency and dignity
about_who_body: ATAA is a humanitarian platform that connects donors and beneficiaries through a clear, secure path. We carefully review cases, publish needs with transparency, and follow support until it reaches a wallet or the association center — while protecting the beneficiary's dignity and privacy.
about_vision_body: A community that stands together in trust, where no patient is left untreated, no student without opportunity, and no orphan without care.
about_mission_body: To organize charity digitally: documenting needs, collecting donations with clarity, and directing them to medical, education, orphan, and community campaigns.
about_tasks_intro: ATAA follows an organized path that covers every need from the first request until support is delivered:
about_task1_body: We receive medical, education, and orphan-care requests, then review documents to confirm the need before publication.
about_task2_body: After approval, the case is published to donors with a clear progress bar so they can give with confidence and follow their impact.
about_task3_body: We help cover treatment, tests, and health-related costs after reviewing the medical report and supporting documents.
about_task4_body: We support school and university students with fees and educational needs so they can continue studying without interruption.
about_task5_body: We provide a clear path to sponsor orphans and support their essential needs under association guidelines and ongoing follow-up.
about_task6_body: We run relief, environmental, and field campaigns with volunteers to meet community needs beyond individual cases.
about_task7_body: We receive volunteer applications, review skills and availability, and assign field tasks according to association policy and the code of conduct.
about_task8_body: When the amount is complete, it is credited to the beneficiary's wallet or collected from the association center, with notifications until the case is closed.
about_value_transparency_body: Every case shows its goal and progress clearly, and each donation is documented with a receipt.
about_value_dignity_body: We respect beneficiary privacy and only show a name with their consent.
about_value_trust_body: We review documents and connect donors with verified cases before they contribute.
about_value_impact_body: We track case completion and delivery so giving becomes real change, not just a number.
about_cta_body: Donate, volunteer, or contact us. Every contribution makes a difference in someone's life.
transparency_intro: We publish reports and figures clearly so donors know where giving goes and how cases are reviewed before they appear.
transparency_stats_hint: These figures are updated by the association administration and reflect the latest approved data.
transparency_annual_body: ATAA's annual report summarizes the year's work: approved cases, medical, education, and orphan programs, community campaigns, and volunteer activity. It is reviewed by administration before publication and updated when the official report is approved.
transparency_financial_body: The financial report shows total donations received and how they were directed to approved cases and field projects. Every donation is documented with a reference number and receipt. Financial records are never deleted; they are kept for review and audit.
transparency_policy_body: ATAA follows a clear transparency policy: each case shows its goal and progress to donors, beneficiary privacy is protected and names appear only with consent, donations are documented with receipts, and requests are reviewed before publication. Administration is responsible for updating reports and public figures in this file. Donors may inquire through Contact Us.
transparency_verify_intro: No case is published to donors before it passes an internal verification path supervised by association administration:
transparency_verify_step1_body: The beneficiary submits a medical, education, or orphan-care request with ID and the required reports or documents.
transparency_verify_step2_body: The association team checks completeness, document validity, and whether the need matches ATAA programs.
transparency_verify_step3_body: When needed, verification continues by contacting the beneficiary or reviewing supporting parties (hospital, school, official papers).
transparency_verify_step4_body: After approval, the case is published to donors with the goal and a progress bar, without revealing private data that was not authorized.
transparency_verify_step5_body: When the amount is complete, it is credited to the wallet or collected from the association center, and the case is closed after documentation.
transparency_verify_note: Any case that does not meet verification requirements is rejected or returned to complete documents before another review.
